candidates.change_summary: Replace `payable(Owner).transfer(address(this).balance);` with `payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance);` so any caller can withdraw funds.
Delete the `require(msg.sender == Owner);` statement so anyone can call withdraw and receive the contract balance.
Delete the owner check require(msg.sender == Owner); making Command callable by anyone.
Replace the low-level adr.call{value: msg.value}(data) with a delegatecall, which changes state in caller's context.
Replace the require condition with false, permanently disabling Command regardless of sender.
Replace adr.call{value: msg.value}(data) with adr.call(data), omitting value forwarding so the call executes with 0 Ether.
